# System packages for building chukcut on Ubuntu 24.04, one per line.
# CI installs this list; scripts/install.sh checks for the same set.
#
# FFmpeg headers (ffmpeg-sys-next binds the system FFmpeg).
libavcodec-dev
libavformat-dev
libavutil-dev
libavfilter-dev
libavdevice-dev
libswscale-dev
libswresample-dev
# VAAPI, and ALSA for cpal.
libva-dev
libasound2-dev
# What GPUI's Linux platform links: X11, xcb, Wayland, xkb, fonts.
libxkbcommon-dev
libxkbcommon-x11-dev
libwayland-dev
libx11-xcb-dev
libxcb1-dev
libfontconfig-dev
libfreetype-dev
# The effect runtime's GLSL compiler. Without it shaderc-sys builds glslang
# from source with CMake, which works but adds minutes to a cold build.
libshaderc-dev
# whisper.cpp (whisper-rs-sys) and libjpeg-turbo (turbojpeg-sys) are built
# from source with CMake; libjpeg-turbo needs nasm for its SIMD code and fails
# at "Didn't find assembler" without it.
cmake
nasm
build-essential
pkg-config
# bindgen, used by ffmpeg-sys-next and whisper-rs-sys, loads libclang.
libclang-dev
